# system

Linux-only machine maintenance: disk reclamation, package tarballs, webcam, and finding a Raspberry Pi on the LAN.

---

## `system_enable_webcam`

Load the USB video kernel module, for a webcam that did not come up.

**Usage**

```sh
system_enable_webcam
```

**Examples**

```sh
system_enable_webcam
```

**Requires** `modprobe`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/system.sh:124`](../../modules/linux/system.sh#L124)

---

## `system_find_raspberry_pi`

Ping-sweep the LAN and print the addresses of any Raspberry Pi, matched on the Pi Foundation MAC prefixes.

**Usage**

```sh
system_find_raspberry_pi [cidr] [interface]
```

**Examples**

```sh
system_find_raspberry_pi 192.0.2.0/24
```

**Requires** `nmap`, `ip`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/system.sh:102`](../../modules/linux/system.sh#L102)

---

## `system_free_disk_space`

Report reclaimable disk space, then optionally free it: package caches, Go module and build caches, yarn and yay caches, and the systemd journal. Shows sizes and asks before deleting anything.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes package and build caches and vacuums the systemd journal to one day of history. Everything removed is regenerable, but a later rebuild or reinstall will have to download again.

**Usage**

```sh
system_free_disk_space
```

**Examples**

```sh
system_free_disk_space
```

**Requires** `du`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/system.sh:21`](../../modules/linux/system.sh#L21)

**See also** `path_size`

---

## `system_tarball_package`

Bundle every file an installed pacman package owns into a tarball, for copying onto a machine that cannot reach the repositories.

**Usage**

```sh
system_tarball_package <package> [output-dir]
```

**Examples**

```sh
system_tarball_package openssl ~/transfer
```

**Requires** `pacman`, `tar`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/system.sh:70`](../../modules/linux/system.sh#L70)

---

## `system_test_webcam`

Show a live preview from the webcam, to check it works.

**Usage**

```sh
system_test_webcam [device]
```

**Examples**

```sh
system_test_webcam /dev/video0
```

**Requires** `mplayer`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/system.sh:134`](../../modules/linux/system.sh#L134)

**See also** `system_enable_webcam`
